limitations: answer_format=verbatim_extracts means model-selected source samples; it does not provide free-form summaries or validated inference. Exact quoting does not establish source truth, relevance of every excerpt, causation, representativeness or full-corpus conclusions.

Only one real model grounding request was made. Its three excerpts were compared against complete delivered fields, stable IDs, source URLs and institution associations. This is not an exhaustive hallucination evaluation.

The one real request ran before research metadata rebuilt from d01dd7b08af78916c9ff to a8acd9d0b712fbe06a65. Source data version f064c896c123cbf4 is unchanged; final version/status checks were performed separately without another real model call.

The JS fixtures extract helper locations from source and execute their behavior; these checks are not complete browser acceptance or XSS certification.
No broad API fuzzing, production saturation, exhaustive prompt-injection evaluation or cost forecast is claimed. Relay health alone does not guarantee next upstream-model success.
GitHub commit, GitHub Pages deployment, final rebuild and final browser acceptance remain the main agent responsibilities, not completion claims in this report.

open_findings.problem: Model-proposed aliases are validated for syntax/scope but not equivalence; an unknown concept can be ORed with an unrelated generic term.
open_findings.fix: Constrain added aliases to independently validated equivalence or a trusted alias vocabulary; reject an unverifiable replacement instead of converting an unknown entity/topic into broad OR matches.

open_findings.problem: A content-free reference/citation request with no user history becomes structured-scope browsing and supplies an arbitrary first record to answer generation.

open_findings.fix: For non-count chat, reject or clarify a request with no substantive concepts and no uniquely established user source before selecting evidence or calling generation; do not use a scope first record as a presumed referent.

open_findings.problem: A source score question containing the noun 资料 is classified as a database-record count; the count path also precedes empty/ambiguous source handling.
